items.title: Campus Bus Route 2 (Shibgonj to Campus)
items.summary: Campus bus route 2 departs Shibgonj Point at 8:15 AM and 9:45 AM directly to Bateshwar campus. Free for all students with university ID.
items.details: Bus stops: Shibgonj -> Tilagor -> Bateshwar campus. Return trips depart campus at 2:00 PM and 5:15 PM.
